derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Consumer electronics retail: TVs and appliances), not the owner's list. Price spread in this category: CONVERGED (flagships within 3-8% across retailers). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
